title: Per-event model evaluation arrays (native SPA2M / SPA2M+ParT)
description: Documents the field-level contract of the .npz file each of the CONTROL (native SPA2M) and TEST (SPA2M+ParT) arms must produce over the identical 400,000-event holdout_A cohort. CORRECTED 2026-09-10 (see PREREGISTRATION.md Amendment 2026-09-10): the 2026-09-09 version of this schema required precomputed higgs1_assignment_correct/higgs2_assignment_correct booleans, which silently assumed a canonical, symmetry-safe H1-vs-H2 labeling that does not exist -- the two Higgs candidates are an explicit PERMUTATIONS.EVENT: [h1,h2] symmetry in this project's own SPA-Net event topology (event_config/trackb_hh4b.yaml), and neither the model's output-slot order nor any truth-storage convention is guaranteed to respect a fixed physical H1/H2 identity across events. This version instead requires the RAW predicted and truth jet indices (pred_b1..pred_b4, truth_b1..truth_b4, matching the naming convention already established and working in paper_exports/track_b_harvey_tail_characterization_20260825_v1/work/{part2_spanet_assignment.py,part6_pairing_accuracy_and_mass.py}), and code/evaluate_multi_model.py computes all reconstruction correctness CENTRALLY via a symmetry-invariant match (matching the official SPANet library's own argmax-over-event-permutations methodology, spanet/network/jet_reconstruction/jet_reconstruction_validation.py) -- never by trusting a precomputed correctness boolean. This is a documentation/validation schema for the logical field set of an .npz archive (each property below is one array, all arrays sharing length = n_events, sorted by event_id before comparison) -- not a JSON instance of the data itself.

event_id.description: native_hdf5_row_index. Primary key for CONTROL/TEST/native10M-if-paired matching.

assignment_defined.description: Whether a truth assignment exists for this event (matchability gate; typically signal-only, but not assumed -- computed from truth, not from process). Must be consistent with truth_b1 != -1 (both express the same matchability condition; kept as an explicit field rather than relying on sentinel-detection alone).

pred_b1.description: REQUIRED, replaces the 2026-09-09 higgs1/higgs2 booleans (Amendment 2026-09-10). Jet index (0..9, into this event's up-to-10 selected jets) of the first jet of the model's first predicted Higgs-candidate pair. Always present (predictions exist for background too), matching part2_spanet_assignment.py's pred.assignments[0] extraction (h1_idx[:,0]).

pred_b2.description: REQUIRED. Second jet of the model's first predicted pair (pred.assignments[0][:,1]).

pred_b3.description: REQUIRED. First jet of the model's second predicted pair (pred.assignments[1][:,0]).

pred_b4.description: REQUIRED. Second jet of the model's second predicted pair (pred.assignments[1][:,1]).

truth_b1.description: REQUIRED. Jet index of the first jet of one truth Higgs-candidate pair, or -1 where assignment_defined is false -- matches truth_targets_400k.npz's own b1 convention (paper_exports/track_b_harvey_tail_characterization_20260825_v1/work/part3_event_listing_and_truth.py: valid_truth = (b1 != -1)).

truth_b2.description: REQUIRED. Partner jet of truth_b1 (same truth pair). -1 where assignment_defined is false.

truth_b3.description: REQUIRED. First jet of the other truth Higgs-candidate pair. -1 where assignment_defined is false.

truth_b4.description: REQUIRED. Partner jet of truth_b3. -1 where assignment_defined is false.

higgs_mass_1.description: Reconstructed di-jet mass under the predicted assignment, candidate 1 (mass of the dijet formed by pred_b1,pred_b2). Secondary/descriptive diagnostic only -- not implicated in the H1<->H2 correctness-symmetry audit, unchanged.

higgs_mass_2.description: Reconstructed di-jet mass under the predicted assignment, candidate 2.

n_jets.description: Real jet multiplicity (native MASK.sum() for this event). code/evaluate_multi_model.py hard-asserts min(n_jets[assignment_defined]) >= 4 before computing the le4/eq4 strata (verified, not assumed).

part_embedding_norm_mean.description: OPTIONAL, TEST-only. Mean L2 norm of the retained (20-dim) ParT embedding across this event's real jets. NaN/absent for CONTROL and for native10M.

jet_pt_leading.description: OPTIONAL, for the pT stratification diagnostic.

jet_eta_leading.description: OPTIONAL, for the eta stratification diagnostic.
